title: fix(plugin-list): a drill's related-record condition reads as a labelled locked chip
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36507
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在仪表盘或报表上按「客户行业」这类关联字段钻取后，弹出列表顶部那枚锁定的条件标签，从「所属客户：= [object Object]」变成「所属客户的行业：科技」（英文界面为「Account › Industry: Technology」）。
- 为什么做：属于「报表与仪表盘」专题，补上钻取弹窗那张卡留下的另一半，让读者看懂这份名单是按什么筛出来的。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这枚标签的文字，列表里筛出的记录不变；读不到关联对象的定义时退回显示原始字段名，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/conditionModel.ts` — `readViewConditions` reads the nested-relation form (a lookup whose condition is one related field equal to one scalar), as written and as lowered to the triple `[lookup, '=', { field: V }]`, into one locked chip whose `field` is the path `lookup.field` and whose operator is `equals`. A plain-object value in a triple is never printed any more: a nested condition the chip cannot say as one equality (several fields, an operator map, a deeper relation, a non-`=` operator) reads as the field-less 「View filter」 chip, which the model's header already promised for any shape it does not read. New module-internal helper `relationPathOf` (not exported from the package barrel). The plain-object test is `isPlainRecord` imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, not a local copy (`check:spec-symbols` refuses a local declaration under a spec export's name).
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/ListConditionControls.tsx` — `viewChipText` labels a path chip as `relationPath(lookup label, related field label)` + the value through `describeConditionValue` on the related field, so a select's option label shows. New hook `useRelatedConditionFields` reads the related object's definition (`getObjectSchema(referenceTo)`, one read per distinct target, only while such a chip is on screen, keyed on the target names) and translates the field and option labels with `useSafeFieldLabel` (`fields.OBJECT.FIELD`, `fieldOptions.OBJECT.FIELD.VALUE`), falling back to the declared label, then the raw name. No record-name read is made for a path chip.
- `listConditions.chips.relationPath` added to the default translations and to all eleven locale packs, each in its own word order (`{{lookup}} › {{field}}` in en/de/es/fr/pt-BR, `{{lookup}}的{{field}}` zh-Hans/zh-Hant, `{{lookup}}の{{field}}` ja, `{{lookup}}의 {{field}}` ko, `{{field}} ({{lookup}})` ru/ar).
- `.changeset/36507-drill-relation-chip.md` — patch, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

No new public ListView prop, no objectql change, no change to the filter's execution shape: the chip is locked, as the card rules.

**Request count:** a list whose view filter carries a relation-path condition makes one more `getObjectSchema` call per related object (the HotCRM drill: `crm_account`, once). The ObjectStack adapter serves it from its `metadataCache`. Lists with no such condition make no new call (pinned by the CONTROL case).

**Shape measured:** PR #36461's `drillConditions.ts` (read at its head `5af2f6e3`) keeps the nested relation part as the list's base `filter` (`{ crm_account: { industry: V } }`). `ListViewBlock`'s `ElementDataSourceGate` lowers it through `toFilterNode` → `convertFiltersToAST`, whose nested-relation arm writes `[field, '=', condition]`. So the list's `readViewConditions` receives the triple, which matches the card's measured chip (`data-field=crm_account`, 「所属客户：= [object Object]」). Both that triple and the card's written form are read.

## Tests

Pins live in the shared harness `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/__tests__/listConditions.test.tsx` as a new top-level `describe` (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes into that file), not in new per-card files:

- model: the triple, the written object, the array element; two unreadable nested shapes read as the field-less chip; CONTROL `['amount', '>=', 10]` unchanged.
- en: chip reads `Account › Industry: Technology`, `data-field="crm_account.industry"`, one `getObjectSchema('crm_account')`, no `find`.
- zh-CN (I18nProvider, app bundle with `fields.crm_account.industry` and `fieldOptions.crm_account.industry.technology`): chip reads `所属客户的行业：科技`, the aria-label too.
- fallbacks: lookup not among the list's fields ⇒ `crm_account › industry: equals technology`, no read; definition read rejects ⇒ `Account › industry: equals technology`.
- CONTROL: a same-object view condition reads `Amount: >= 10`, `data-field="amount"`, and reads no definition.

Existing tests changed: none.

## Acceptance notes

- The fallback chip text when the related definition cannot be read keeps the operator word (`equals technology`): that is `describeConditionValue`'s existing wording for an unknown field, the same a same-object chip on an unknown field gets.
- A relation-path condition inside an `and` AST node at the top (a drill whose base filter keeps two or more parts, e.g. a nested relation plus an `$or`) still reads as one 「View filter」 chip: the model reads `and` nodes that way for every condition, and the card names only the single nested form. Not changed here.
- Latin-script packs (de/es/fr/pt-BR) carry the same format string as en; the non-Latin packs carry their own word order, which `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` asks for.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/__tests__/listConditions.test.tsx -t "related record"` ⇒ 6 passed.

Read first: `conditionModel.ts` `tripleChip` (the plain-object arm), `ListConditionControls.tsx` `useRelatedConditionFields`, then `viewChipText`.
